login.title: Log in
login.intro: Use the account provided by your company administrator.
login.loginAscii: Use English letters, numbers and symbols only, with no spaces.
login.helpTitle: Need access or help signing in?
login.help: Contact your company administrator. Accounts are created by your company.
login.panelText: Sign in to the delivery, accounting and people workflows your company has given you access to.
login.panelAccessText: Accounts are created by your company. Contact your administrator if you need access.

errors.invalidCredentials: Unable to log in. Check your email or username and password, then try again.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Log in again.

picker.title: Choose a workspace
picker.intro: Only workspaces you have permission to enter are shown.
picker.platformDescription: Available only with separate platform permissions.
picker.loadFailed: Your workspaces could not be loaded.

noAccess.title: Company access unavailable
noAccess.description: Your account is signed in, but no active company workspace is available. Contact your company administrator.

notFound.title: Workspace not found
notFound.description: This company isn't in your list of workspaces.

unavailable.title: Can't reach the server
unavailable.description: The server didn't answer. Check your connection, then try again.
